image.alt: Mmm! original bilingual Pegasus Spiele 2015 box front

fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: The publisher-submitted 30 June 2015 press release at https://www.lifepr.de/pressemitteilung/pegasus-spiele-verlags-und-medienvertriebsgesellschaft-mbh/mmm-ist-spiel-der-spiele/boxid/544711 labels this artwork Mmm! Cover. Its attachment page https://www.lifepr.de/anlagen/637527 identifies Pegasus Spiele as publisher and copyright holder and labels the image Mmm! Cover 2D. The German and British flags on the box match the bilingual 2015 edition discussed here. Reduced to 250 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The bravest player takes the three dice and begins the cooperative game.
clarifications: Players then take turns in sequence, trying to gather food before the cat reaches the pantry.
